'''Star Tours Flight 1021''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and its estimated time of arrival at the spaceport's Gate 2B was 1515 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1610.
